claims.content: The customer wants to complete checkout and payment of won auction items by choosing which items to pay for now, selecting a shipping method/speed, and selecting a payment type.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The customer wants to complete checkout and payment of won auction items by choosing which items to pay for now, selecting a shipping method/speed, and selecting a payment type.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The customer chooses which items to pay for now, selects a shipping method/speed, selects a payment type, and completes the payment transaction(s).
scope_contract.start_boundary: The customer begins checkout by choosing which items to pay for now.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The customer has selected a shipping method/speed and payment type and completed payment for the selected transaction(s).
in_scope_actions: Choosing which items to pay for now
Completing payment for the selected transaction(s)
variant_dimensions: Which items are included in the current payment

claims.content: Customer
The system has identified the customer as the winner of at least one auction, so the customer has won auction items available to pay for.
The customer has registered payment method information in their registration data before checkout begins.
The customer clicks the 'Winnings Alert' link and is taken to the 'Returning Winners Payments' page.
The customer chooses which items to pay for now by checking the 'Pay Now' checkbox next to each item in the list of won but unpaid items.
The system offers the customer a choice of shipping methods.
The customer selects a shipping speed by choosing between 'USPS Standard' and 'Expedited (5-day)' via radio buttons.
The customer selects a payment type by clicking either the PayPal logo/radio button or the Amazon Payments logo/radio button.
The system presents the checkout process for the selected payment provider.
The customer completes the payment transaction(s) through the selected payment provider's checkout process.
Upon completion, the customer is returned to a Thank You page that uses the global header and footer and includes a prominent link to the JTVauctions.com home page.

Diverges from Step 4: The customer clicks the 'Checkout Later' button/radio button instead of selecting a payment provider. The system grays out the page and disables all links, then displays a DIV layer stating the customer may return to pay anytime within 7 days (168 hours) after winning, but unpaid orders will be cancelled after that window. The DIV provides 'Return to Payments', which closes the DIV and re-enables page links so the customer can resume the payment flow (Steps 5-7), and 'JTVauctions Homepage', which navigates the customer away.

Diverges from Step 5: If the customer selected PayPal at Step 4, the system immediately takes the customer to the PayPal checkout process on a PayPal-hosted page instead of presenting an in-page checkout widget.

Diverges from Step 5: If the customer selected Amazon Payments at Step 4, the Amazon Payments checkout widget loads on the current page without navigating away; the background is grayed out and all other links are disabled.

At Step 4, if the customer selects PayPal as the payment type, the on-page shipping preferences do not apply; the system displays a note in the 'My Shipping Preferences' section stating that shipping settings only apply to credit card orders and that PayPal users will be given a shipping option during the PayPal checkout process instead. The customer is directed to the PayPal checkout (Step 5) without using the normal on-page shipping-speed selection.

At Step 6, if the 168-hour (7-day) deadline expires before the customer completes the payment transaction(s), the system cancels the unpaid order(s), places the item(s) in a Hold status, and may suspend the customer's account; the use case terminates unsuccessfully.
The payment transaction(s) for the items the customer selected to pay for now are completed successfully.

Because payment is completed before the 7-day (168-hour) deadline, the associated order(s) remain active rather than being automatically cancelled, the customer's account remains unlocked, and the customer retains bidding privileges.
The system returns the customer to a Thank You page that uses the global header and footer and includes a prominent link to the JTVauctions.com home page.
